# Insulation & More

> The UK's premier supplier of pipe, duct, and building insulation products with comprehensive cladding solutions from leading brands.

Insulation & More specializes in high-performance thermal and acoustic insulation materials for HVAC, refrigeration, and building applications. The site offers products from industry-leading manufacturers including Kaiflex, Rockwool, Isover, Armacell, and Kingspan, alongside comprehensive accessories and installation support.

## Key Topics

- Pipe Insulation
- Duct Insulation
- Thermal Insulation
- Pipe Lagging
- Insulation Cladding
- Kaiflex
- Rockwool
- Isover
- Armacell
- Aluminium Cladding
- Aluzinc Cladding
- Acoustic Insulation
- Polyisobutylene (PIB)
- Insulation Accessories
- Vapor Barrier Systems
